MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The #8 finishing washers felt like a plausible companion to my recent #8 wood screws because they could provide a cleaner finish, provided the screw heads fit.",
    "The washers connected to an actual fastening need in my history, which made them more relevant than supplies for an unrelated repair."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Hose clamps, the pulley, the stock tank plug, and threaded knobs serve specific repairs I have not shown a need for; being hardware does not make them useful for my wood and drywall work.",
    "Magnets, heat shrink tubing, and adhesive mounting tape require uses I do not currently have. Carpet protection also assumes a project detail my purchases do not establish.",
    "Duct tape might be useful for an occasional repair, but eighteen rolls are more than I need right now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in nails, screws, and anchors seemed to be stretched into interest in almost any maintenance or workshop supply.",
    "Different ways of attaching things seemed to be treated as interchangeable, even though screws, hose clamps, magnets, and adhesive tape solve different problems."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The intended material and exact fit matter to me: my recent fasteners are for wood and drywall, and even the #8 washers depend on compatibility with my screw heads.",
    "Quantity matters alongside usefulness; buying packs of fasteners does not mean I need bulk quantities of every repair supply.",
    "My medicine cups and vacuum bags reflect separate needs, so I would not assume every recent purchase belongs to one construction project."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in fastening supplies but extended it too broadly beyond compatible items for my current needs."
}
